## `POST /api/v1/row-filters`

Create a row filter

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Answers 409 when an access file manages the scope; `override_managed` with `override_reason` overrides it (ADMIN on the instance; audited).

Restricts which rows of a table a principal or group sees, by a SQL condition. The filter binds to the table, not its name. Needs `MANAGE_POLICY` on the instance. Answers 404 when the principal, group or table does not exist and 422 for a condition that is not valid or is longer than the server's statement limit.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `override_managed` | query | no | true or false | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency. Needs the ADMIN role on the instance and `override_reason`; audited, and shown as drift until the next apply. |
| `override_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line; with `override_managed=true`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `RowFilterCreate`

| `table` | text | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/row-filters`

List the row filters of a principal, group or table

Give exactly one of `principal_name`, `group_name` or `environment` with `namespace` and `table`; a row filter always belongs to one table, so there is no list of all of them. Needs `MANAGE_POLICY` on the instance. Answers 404 when no principal or group has the name given and 422 when none of those combinations is given.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `principal_name` | query | no | text or null | List this principal's own direct filters. |
| `group_name` | query | no | text or null | List this group's own direct filters. |
| `environment` | query | no | text or null | The environment to match, for a table-scoped listing. |
| `namespace` | query | no | text or null | The dot-joined namespace to match, for a table-scoped listing. |
| `table` | query | no | text or null | The table to match, for a table-scoped listing. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `RowFilterOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `DELETE /api/v1/row-filters/{row_filter_id}`

Revoke a row filter

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Answers 409 when an access file manages the scope; `override_managed` with `override_reason` overrides it (ADMIN on the instance; audited).

Needs `MANAGE_POLICY` on the instance. Answers 404 when there is no such row filter.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `row_filter_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The row filter's id. |
| `override_managed` | query | no | true or false | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency. Needs the ADMIN role on the instance and `override_reason`; audited, and shown as drift until the next apply. |
| `override_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line; with `override_managed=true`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |
